root_cause_label: Incorrect Dependency Strategy and Missing Code Fixes
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent attempted to downgrade numpy to 2.0.0 instead of patching the Cython source files for numpy 2.x API compatibility, and then stalled in a loop waiting for the pip install to complete.
t_err_evidence: cd /app/pyknotid && python setup.py build_ext --inplace (run before cython/numpy installed)
t_commit_evidence: Once the agent committed to the numpy downgrade strategy at step 6, all subsequent steps (7-12) either stall on the same pip install or retry it; no code patching is ever attempted, making the wrong approach locked in.
t_surface_evidence: Cython or numpy could not be imported, so cythonised calculation functions will not be built.
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on the false premise that numpy was not installed or was the wrong version to be installed, so it tried to install numpy==2.0.0. In reality, numpy 2.4.4 was already installed but the pyknotid Cython source files used deprecated numpy C-API calls incompatible with numpy 2.x — the correct fix was to patch the source files, not downgrade numpy.
forewarning_evidence: running build_ext (no extensions actually built; cythonised functions will not be built)
